sources.title: alethe-agents README.md
sources.locator: What Alethe Is; Supported Platforms; Workspace; Orchestration; Stay in control
sources.finding: Free local-first desktop workspace built with Tauri/Rust/React/xterm.js. Independent PTYs, cross-agent handoff, MCP/skills, worktrees, Git/PR review and opt-in orchestration/remote control are documented.

sources.title: alethe-agents docs/OVERVIEW.md
sources.finding: Tauri 2/Rust backend with React frontend and xterm.js/portable-pty. Groups contain projects with terminal/subtab sessions; local JSON and scrollback store workspace state.

sources.title: alethe-agents docs/FEATURES.md
sources.locator: Workspace; PTYs; Local accounts; Resume; Memory controls
sources.finding: Workspace PTYs have separate sessions, persisted scrollback, resume and local profiles. Closing/rearranging views does not kill backend processes.

sources.title: alethe-agents docs/ORCHESTRATOR_ROADMAP.md
sources.finding: This MCP-delegate board is distinct from disconnected scheduler/GSD task DAG. Claude planner delegates to steerable/approvable Codex workers; inline worker diff and clean worktree apply are shipped. Codex planner and real Claude worker end-to-end were not established by baseline.

sources.title: alethe-agents LICENSE
sources.finding: Application source uses AGPL-3.0-or-later is explicitly stated in the README License section; LICENSE supplies the license text.

sources.title: alethe-agents docs/PRIVACY.md
sources.locator: Local data; Export; Secrets; Local telemetry; Network surfaces
sources.finding: Local workspace retained in profiles; update/usage polling on by default. No first-party analytics uploader stated. Profile ZIP/settings export differ; cloud/third-party copies need separate deletion. Optional remote input uses LAN transport.

sources.title: alethe-agents v1.7.0 release
sources.finding: Release published 20 September 2026. README identifies early public release and unsigned Windows builds.

sources.title: Alethe README, overview
sources.locator: README.md line 58 (overview) and lines 95-98 (Agents table), release tag v1.7.0 (commit 80e44a3)
sources.finding: Every agent CLI, including claude and codex, runs unmodified in a real PTY inside the desktop workspace.

sources.title: Alethe privacy guide, credentials
sources.locator: docs/PRIVACY.md lines 81-85 (credential handling), release tag v1.7.0 (commit 80e44a3)
sources.finding: Claude usage polling reads Claude Code's own stored sign-in token, and Codex usage goes through a codex app-server subprocess, so each CLI keeps its own native authentication.

sources.finding: Alethe v1.7.0 lists Antigravity as a terminal agent, resolves it to agy and builds native conversation-resume arguments.
